dataList.content:
What remained inside the hall after the battle was devastating.
经过几番死斗后，建筑内的景象已经变得相当惨烈。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Tubitang
大观园 凸碧堂

dataList.content:
Many in the audience seats had fled, as the seats that were once brimming with people were only half-filled...
许多观众们逃跑后便没再回来，观众席已经有大约一半变成了空位……

... and the candidate zone down here was littered with bodies of candidates who were mauled to death.
这个原本聚集着参与者的地方，现在只剩下了许多被撕咬过的尸体……

Meanwhile, the jar monsters, having eaten their fill, had already crawled back into the jar.
吞噬了众多观众的怪物们，若无其事地变回了瓮的模样。

I looked around and saw some candidates still holding tightly onto the treasures they each had brought to the contest, even as they drew their last breaths.
也有人虽然尚存一息，却依旧紧紧抱着自己带来的物品，渐渐死去。

In midst of all this destruction stood the cause of this chaos, watching the slaughter play out with assured confidence...
而那个悠然自得地旁观着这一切的罪魁祸首……

Heheh, ha, ahahaha!
哈、哈哈！

How will you attain freedom from aging, how will you argue freedom from death, with minds so dull and bodies so frail?
如此愚蠢又懦弱，怎敢妄想不老、妄论不死。

What say you, judges?!
如何！

I present before you not only the clue to immortality, but also a treasure that brings ruin to those who would dare to deceive you! Here is my answer to the perennial question!
除了不老不死的线索之外，我还带来了能葬送撒谎之人的宝物。这就是我的答案！

... So you have brought us the clay of the jar.
……看来你取来了那瓮之黏土。

It can be said that those who failed to survive this do not qualify as Family Hierarch candidates, yes?
没能活下来的人们，应该被认为是不具备竞争家主的资格吧？

Pan of the Xue family passes.
薛家薛蟠，合格。

He gets to pass when he almost got everyone in here killed...?
他差点就害死了在场的所有人……居然还能算合格……

All that matters is that what he has brought meets their standards.
我们只能认为这一切都符合他们的标准。

Looks like he managed to get two birds with one stone. He eliminated the distracting rabble from the competition.
还顺手早早处理掉了弱小的竞争对手，对他来说就是一石二鸟。

If we ever run into that bastard in round 2, you better let me take more than a few swings at 'im.
要是在第二轮中遇到他的话，我可绝不会揍他几顿就算完事……

Twenty-eighth candidate... Shi Dazhen from the Shi family.
……第二十八位参与者，史家达真。

But no one walked up to the platform.
但是，没有任何人登台。

... As he has failed to appear... he is eliminated by default.
……因未露面，落选。

Jia Zheng called a few more names thereafter, but...
之后也陆续叫了好几个名字，但是……

Twenty-ninth candidate...
第二十九位……

Thirtieth candidate...
第三十位……

... The number of candidates has clearly been culled.
……人数明显减少了啊。

But none appeared.
许久过去，也没有人走出来。

Disappointingly M.B.
净是群乌·众。

Yeah... all the mediocre bunch got wiped out from that attack...
确实……乌合之众好像全都一命呜呼了……

And the leftovers are exhausted.
剩下的也都是群筋疲力尽气喘吁吁的家伙罢了。

Ryōshū looked around as though she was doing some sort of critique.
良秀仿佛是在做出评价一般环顾着四周。

... Hah? That lug...
……哈？那个大块头是……

That motherfu—
你这狗……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content: Hwell, I'll be... thought you'd gone and vanished into the earth! What the hell you doin' crawlin' 'round out here? 呦嗬！我还琢磨你人上哪儿去了，这猛地就碰着了？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Girl! I saw ya givin' me the evil eye, 'least have the decency to say hi, eh?
哎呀嗨~！都瞅见我了咋不吱一声啊！

<Ryō... Ryōshū, that guy's talking to you, right?>
<良……良秀？那个人，是在对你说话吧？>

And in a very, very rare display of raw emotion...
这真的是非常、非常罕见的场面……

... I realized that she was anxious... and furious.
良秀居然露出了充满焦躁与愤怒的表情。

Oh... do you know him?
这……这位是熟人吗？

What an absolute unit... Bloke's got to be at least two metres tall.
这大块头……个子快有两米高了吧？

... Do not look at that man, Dante. And everyone, avert your eyes as well.
……请不要看向此人，但丁。还有各位也一样……

It is strongly recommended that we do not say a word to him.
我奉劝各位什么话都不要说。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
That's right, ya shrimps. Ya gotta first wrack them teensy' brains o' yours, gotta think real hard 'bout whether you even come close to my rank before runnin' ya mouths, ya hear?
可不是嘛，想和我搭话，得先掂量掂量自个儿够不够格，对不？

That shithead, Lei Heng... he's a Finger.
那家伙……是手指的人。雷横。

The Thumb is a Syndicate with the strictest adherence to rigid hierarchical structure even among the Fingers.
拇指是各手指中在上命下从方面最为严格的帮派。

And his placement in the hierarchy is the highest even among their Capos—his rank is immediately beneath the position of a Sottocapo, or underboss.
而此人……则在拇指的指挥官里也属于是仅次于二老板的最高阶级。

A small mistake could drag us into a battle we do not want to fight. Please order everyone to not say a word, Dante.
哪怕是极小的失误也可能演变为激烈的战斗，所以请您下令让全员保持肃静，但丁。

<I don't know what's going on... But I get it. You're saying that we're this close to having another Ricardo hunting us down, right?>
<虽然不太清楚……但总之就是搞不好会变成中指里卡多的那种情况？>

<Yeah, let's avoid that. Do as Faust asks, everyone.>
<……总之大伙先按照浮士德说的做吧。>

Lei Heng began stomping his way through the crowd toward us, casually but forcefully shoving anyone in his way to the sides. His gait was blasé and brutish, but I noticed that his eyes were fixed intently on Ryōshū.
雷横以巨大的身躯推搡着观众席的人群，他虽然动作吊儿郎当，但目光却一直都直勾勾地追随着良秀，并一步步向这里走来。

It seemed that among the crowd were some people in higher positions as well, but even they either averted their eyes or voluntarily got out of his way.
虽然也有颇有地位的人们被粗鲁地推了一把……但他们也都是低着眉头一言不发或者提前让出位置而已。

He marched confidently through the frozen crowd, as though he was familiar with this kind of reception, until a cry rang out from the crowd.
仿佛这情况是理所当然的一般，正当他向我们靠近时，有人向他大喊道。

dataList.content:
You there, you big brute! How dare you block young master Nangong Xianhe's view?! I'll have you know that you stand before the retinue of the Nangong family, the house that shall soon be one of the four houses—
喂！你这家伙胆敢挡在我们南宫仙鹤少爷的座位面前……这座位可是未来将成为四大家族之一的，我们南宫家的——

Instead of a reply, we heard a blast of gunpowder, then saw the right arm of the man who spoke out catapult into the air.
疑似枪响的动静传来，随后发言者的右臂被斩下了。

dataList.title:
Daguanyuan
大观园
dataList.content:
AAAAARG—
呃啊啊啊！

The scream muffled as Lei Heng forcibly shoved his giant hand down the man's throat. Then, with the sound of wet meat being pulled apart, he ripped the entire length of the man's tongue out through the mouth.
趁着那人悲鸣的工夫，一只手早已伸入其嘴中，伴随着一阵撕裂声舌头被拔了出来。

Young master Nangong Xianhe, ain't ya? Ya owe me an arm now. Mighty sorry, but ya shoulda kept a tighter leash on ya boy's jawin'.
南宫家的小少爷，你连家里下人的嘴都管不严实，那我可就得卸你一条右边的胳膊咯。

The young master of some prestigious house presented his right hand, though it was clear that he was utterly terrified. Lei Heng proceeded to grab his hand and break it off his forearm like snapping a twig.
听闻此言，某个出身名门的少爷谦卑地伸出了他颤抖的右手……雷横一下子就拽掉了那只手。

I went easy on ya, boy. Seein' a friendly face put me in a good mood.
得亏碰着老熟人，要不咋能饶你这一回呢，消停点别作怪哈。

Anyhoo... I don't reckon ya miss the House of Spiders? Eh, can't imagine why anybody would. Gives me the heebie-jeebies too, whenever I gotta swing by.
你还惦记蜘蛛巢不？也不可能惦记哈。连我每回过去都觉着浑身刺挠。

We got some catchin' up to do later. I'll teach ya how to hold your sword real good right like back when.
赶明儿得来露个面哈。下回还跟那会儿似的，手把手教你握刀。

Weren't mine the best out of 'em all? I thought I taught ya how to make every cut real fuckin' delicious.
哎哎，你寻思寻思……在那帮人堆儿里，就数我教你那耍刀的架势最得劲儿对不？

Ryōshū, now is not yet the time.
<ruby=Ryōshū>良秀</ruby>小姐。现在还不是时候。

Faust whispered to Ryōshū in a low voice without raising her head.
浮士德低着头对着良秀小声说道。

Shut up for a damn second...
闭嘴……

Faust trusts that you still remember the promise made prior to your employment.
浮士德相信，您还记得入职前的约定。

Get that stick outta ya behind, kiddo. I ain't here to pick ya up, I sure as hell ain't tryna teach ya a lesson either like back when.
放松点儿。我又不是来逮你走的，也不打算跟那会儿似的非得教点啥玩意儿。

Your baby's still at that house, ain't that right?
你家孩子还在那宅子里呆着呢。是不？

... Ryōshū was grabbing the hilt of her sword like she was about to unsheathe it.
……良秀握住刀柄，摆出了随时都能发动斩击的架势。

The same sword she refused to unsheathe for the duration of our entire journey.
自我们初次见面以来，从未出鞘过的那把刀。

Huh, am I wrong 'bout that? Just hwat in tarnation happened, then? I ain't exactly nose-deep in them fellers' business, ya gotta understand. Guess somethin' sure as hell went down though, didn't it? 嗯~错了？人不在了？难不成出啥岔子了。那块的事我可不晓得啊。不过瞅这架势，八成是真摊上事儿了吧？

Hyahhh~ Now ain't that somethin'. So, ya really fixin' to unsheathe that blade?  
哎呦~这下可有意思咯。不过你真要拔出那把刀？

... Miss Ryōshū.
……<ruby=Ryōshū>良秀</ruby>小姐。

In a quiet but coldly stern voice, Faust calls Ryōshū's name.
浮士德用冷静的语调向着良秀低声说道。

Ryōshū...
而良秀……

Aw dangit, what in the goshdang... Haah~ My bad, y'all. I really gotta take this. It's the underboss callin', y'all gotta understand.
哎呦，咋了这是。哎~二老板来电话了，这不接不中啊，对吧？

Awrighty then, I'll meetcha'll later. We can talk about your daddies or shoot some other shit then. Seeya 'round, Yoshihide!
下次得空跟我唠唠你们家老爹们的事儿啊，<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>！

The strange man turns around and stomps his way through the crowd again, his booming voice reverberating across the entire hall as he loudly and boisterously answers the call.
伴随着某人响彻大厅的惨叫声，雷横一边接起电话一边再次消失在观众席之中。

<He's gotta be here for the Family Hierarch war, right?>
<想必那个人也和家主之争有关联吧？>

The outcome of the Family Hierarch Evaluation determines the immediately foreseeable future of H Corp., which brings parties of varying, possibly clashing interests here.
不论最后是谁成为家主都将决定H公司的未来走向，因此明面与暗地里的各方势力都在蠢蠢欲动。

Hey, Heathcliff. Noticed you didn't rush ahead this time. I was worried it was going to be like the time with the Middle.
至少这次希斯克利夫先生还挺忍得住的？我还担心要是像中指那次一样惹出了事该怎么办呢。

Tch, I know a thing or two about the Thumb back from my Syndicate days. And about what happened with the Middle—like I said, I had no bloody idea who those things belonged to. Besides, that sod...
嘁，我以前在帮派里过日子的时候也听说过拇指。而且中指那会儿是因为我真的不知道。还有就是那家伙，应该……

... Is more powerful and violent than Ricardo, an individual we had encountered in the past.
可推测为比我们曾经遭遇的里卡多更强且更具威胁的强者。

The Thumb commands its own manner of terror and violence unlike that of the Middle...
拇指带给人的恐惧感别具一格。其凶恶暴戾亦与中指不同……

As we were all sharing our impressions of Lei Heng, I found Ryōshū frozen in place, in the same position she had been in when Lei Heng walked past her, spacing out.
我们都在交谈有关雷横的事情，但良秀却一直以雷横经过时的架势愣愣地站着望向空处。

All the way to the Pinky, huh...
还包括小指么……

Ryōshū muttered something to herself. As even further chaos was about to overtake the crowd and the candidates...
良秀自言自语着，而正当混乱的观众与候选人们越来越吵的时候……

Thirty-second candidate, Jia Qiu.
……第三十二位参与者，贾丘。

Jia Zheng called upon the next candidate.
这个名字刚刚响起……

And, at the mere mention of the name, the chaos that had swallowed the hall immediately settled into a hushed silence.
嘈杂的氛围瞬间就安静了下来。

Jia Qiu walked up to the platform,
走到台上的贾丘……

unaccompanied by his own faction, but not alone.
虽然没有与自身的势力同行，但也并非孤身一人。

<Who are those people next to Jia Qiu...?>
<贾丘带来的那些人是……>

I've never met them before.
我以前从未见过呢。

... Ohh~ Then that must mean that they're big brother Jia Qiu's answers to immortality.
啊~那么，这些人应该就是贾丘大哥有关不老不死的答案了。

Who could they possibly be...?
到底都是什么人啊……

Neither of them appear to be particularly skilled in combat...
从战斗力方面看起来并不卓越……

Yeah, they're both constantly looking around, like they're nervous...
反倒是在不安地环顾四周……

They... are...
那些……人。

Faust believes that they are survivors of the Library.
浮士德认为他们是图书馆的幸存者。

<Survivors?>
<幸存者？>

The only ones who survived the impossible, inevitable odds and the insurmountable force...
在不可避免的不可抗力作用下……

They're the only survivors who may be able to explain that very force. ... Possibly.
仅存的活着、并能解释这件事的人……或许是这样。

Candidate Qiu of the Jia family...
……第一轮评审参与者，贾家贾丘。

Jia Qiu didn't spend much time behind the curtains. He walked out soon after, his steely expression unchanged from when he entered it.
他刚进去没多久，就摆着一模一样的表情退了出来。

The testimony rings true. They are both survivors of the place that soared beyond a Star of the City... before it vanished.
证言属实。确实是从那凌驾于都市之星其上的、最终荡然无存之地生还之人。

It is a shame that we were unable to procure ourselves an invitation then.
现在看来，我们当时未能得到邀请函可是颇为遗憾。

He passes.
合格。

Jia Qiu's expression did not budge.
贾丘的表情纹丝不动。

Anxiety's gotta be a foreign concept to that guy.
他到底有没有紧张过啊？

Then... that covers all the candidates, it seems.
那么……看来已经没有剩下的参与者了。

With the first round complete, to all four families who have graced this hall—
向共聚于此的四大家族致以……

Excuse me~!
请等一下~！

Unlike Jia Qiu, whose appearance plunged the hall into utter stillness, Hong Lu's sudden interjection roused the room to a roaring chaos of confusion once again.
与刚才贾丘登场时的四下无声相反，鸿璐举着手站出来的瞬间场内便已人声鼎沸。

Baoyu, what...?
宝玉……？

I think you might have missed a candidate.
我觉得还剩下了最后一位参与者。

... What do you mean? I believe we have covered every candidate present in the list...
……你这是什么意思？评审候选人的名单已经……

You missed me.
还有我。

Jia Baoyu, of the Jia family, will partake in the Family Hierarch Evaluations.
贾家宝玉，参与家主评审。
